tips.text: Run Conservation for Solaris standing: buy the Tranq Rifle at Neutral, tranquilize wild spawns and use pheromones.
Buy Training and Shelter bonds from Ticker, and check his rotating debts often.
Bring Ivara, or Equinox with sleep, to sleep an animal from range for a perfect capture.
Build all four Models if you build one; each is worth 6,000 Mastery and the parts share resources.
Do not donate a MOA to Legs until it is gilded and levelled the second time.
Before Doer, buy the lures you can reach: Pobbers at Neutral, Virmink at Outworlder and Sawgaw at Rapscallion.
Pick the Bracket for its polarity, not its looks; Tian gives the easy Vazarin at rank 0.
Take the Venerdo Alloy blueprint as your free Outworlder item; it is worth more than the 1,000 standing Model.
Take Training Debt-Bonds from the lowest-tier Eudico bounty; they drop in pairs and never from stage 1.
Mine Noctrul and Venerol first since the build needs them, and trade gems to Smokefinger for standing.
The Solaris grind is a slog you only do once, and the debt-bond changes made it far easier.
